question: Two similar triangles have a similarity ratio of \(3:5\). The smaller triangle has a perimeter of \(12\text{ cm}\). Find the perimeter of the larger triangle. (Unit: cm)
solution: The perimeter ratio equals the similarity ratio: \(12/x=3/5\), so \(x=20\).
